items.generated_en: The words of the Supreme Being B.

items.generated_zh: 听见了，后来魔鬼来把心里的话夺走，使他们不信、不得救。
items.generated_en: I heard it, and later the devil came and took away the words in their hearts, causing them not to believe and not to be saved.

items.generated_zh: 听见时欢喜接受的话，却没有根基。他们暂时信了，但试炼时就跌倒了。
items.generated_en: The words that are joyfully accepted when heard have no foundation. They believe for a time, but fall during trials.

items.generated_zh: 听了，却被生活的忧虑、财富和享乐挤住，不能成熟。
items.generated_en: I listened, but was squeezed by the worries of life, wealth, and pleasure, unable to mature.
items.expected: Hear word, choked by life's cares.

items.generated_zh: 听 至尊者乙 话并遵行的人。
items.generated_en: Those who listen to and follow the words of the Supreme Being B.
